description: A stationary vintage turquoise flatbed truck viewed from its left-rear three-quarter side. It has weathered turquoise metal, a pale cab, two visible wheels, long brown wooden side boards, rear hinges and tow hardware. Concrete paving, buses, trees, lamps, patio furniture, yellow umbrellas and buildings form the urban background.
cameraIntent: Begin at the photographed left-rear view. Make a 19-degree local orbit toward the rear corner with slight translation and lift, preserving the whole truck while revealing bed thickness, rear hardware, wheel spacing and layered plaza parallax.
invariants: The truck, wheels, wooden bed and all background objects remain stationary.
Preserve turquoise weathering, long wooden boards, rear hardware, cab and wheel placement.
No driver, pedestrian or other person appears.

normalization.operation: EXIF orientation, centered uniform cover crop to exact aspect ratio; no stretching or generative editing
